diagnostics.message: Type Error: функция должна возвращать объявленный тип

deviation.rationale: Odin reports 'Type Error: функция должна возвращать <ожидаемый>, но последнее выражение имеет тип <фактический>' (names both types); Zig's checkFunction (zig/core/type_checker.zig) reports only the generic message above, with no type-name formatter available in that file yet (runner.zig's formatTypeName is not reachable from type_checker.zig's own diagnostic-reporting call site). Real, tracked quality gap (worse error message, not a wrong-vs-right correctness bug — both correctly reject the program) — NOT fixed in T053 (out of scope: 'record baselines', not 'improve diagnostics'). Follow-up: add a type-name formatter usable from type_checker.zig and include actual/expected types in this message, matching Odin's.

Odin's CLI renders this same numeric result (mathematically identical, 12499997500000) as '1.24999975e+13' — Odin's fmt.tprintf("%v", f64) switches to scientific notation above ~15 significant digits (same underlying quirk documented for строки.из_числа elsewhere in this project). Zig's renderValue (zig/core/runner.zig) uses Zig's own '{d}' formatter, which does not have this quirk. Expected value above is Zig's (and the mathematically canonical) form — Odin is being retired (specs/010-zig-migration T058/T059), not worth replicating its formatting quirk in Zig.
